ITA-5.19.1 hikkā (hidhmā) हिक्का (हिध्मा)
Hiccup
A disorder characterized by vayu repeatedly and forcefully brought out, accompanied by sound; feeling as if liver; spleen and intestines are being expelled through the mouth; making noise, and causing sudden death.

ITA-5.76.90 hikkābastivyāpat हिक्काबस्तिव्यापत्
Condition of hiccups due to faulty enema therapy
A condition characterized by hiccups.

ITA-5.75.12 hikkāvegarodhaḥ हिक्कावेगरोधः
Disorder due to withholding of hiccups
